description: Every debt with its balance, rate, monthly payment, the month it clears and the interest still to pay, then the debt-free date at today's payments and what paying a bit more would change, and the dates coming up (a fixed rate ending, a 0% deal ending, a term's end). The same plan as the Liabilities page. Use for 'when will I be debt-free', 'what am I paying in interest', 'when does my fix end'.
name: get_liabilities
title: Liabilities and the debt-free date
